paperTitleZh: 生物 全新模擬卷 — 卷二 乙部 應用生態學
paperTitle: Biology Mock — Paper 2 Section B Applied Ecology

parts.label: a(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 以「每個出海日的捕獲量」作為單位捕撈努力量漁獲，計算 1990 年和 2020 年的數值，並寫出單位。（2 分）
parts.questionTextEn: Using "catch per boat-day" as the catch per unit effort, calculate its values in 1990 and 2020, and give the unit. (2 marks)

parts.label: a(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 參考圖 1 和你在 (a)(i) 的答案，解釋為什麼 2000 年後魚 F 的捕獲量下降。（3 分）
parts.questionTextEn: With reference to Figure 1 and your answer in (a)(i), explain why the catch of fish F decreased after 2000. (3 marks)

parts.label: a(iii)
parts.questionTextZh: 參考表 1，解釋為什麼規定使用網目較大的漁網，有助魚 F 種群可持續發展。（3 分）
parts.questionTextEn: With reference to Table 1, explain why requiring the use of nets with a larger mesh size helps the sustainable development of the fish F population. (3 marks)

parts.label: a(iv)
parts.questionTextZh: 除了規定網目大小外，提出兩項有助魚 F 種群恢復的管理措施。（2 分）
parts.questionTextEn: Apart from regulating mesh size, suggest two management measures that can help the population of fish F to recover. (2 marks)

parts.label: b(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 描述 2004 年至 2019 年海豚估算數目與每日高速客輪航次之間的關係。（2 分）
parts.questionTextEn: Describe the relationship between the estimated number of dolphins and the number of daily high-speed ferry trips from 2004 to 2019. (2 marks)

parts.label: b(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 提出三種高速客輪可能導致海豚數目下降的方式。（3 分）
parts.questionTextEn: Suggest three ways in which high-speed ferries may cause a decrease in the number of dolphins. (3 marks)

parts.label: b(iii)
parts.questionTextZh: 有人認為圖 2 證明客輪航次增加是海豚數目下降的唯一原因。評論這說法。（2 分）
parts.questionTextEn: Some people claimed that Figure 2 proves that the increase in ferry trips is the only cause of the decrease in dolphin numbers. Comment on this claim. (2 marks)

parts.label: b(iv)
parts.questionTextZh: 政府計劃在該水域劃設海岸公園。提出海岸公園可以如何幫助保育中華白海豚，並指出一項限制。（3 分）
parts.questionTextEn: The government plans to designate a marine park in the area. Suggest how the marine park can help conserve Chinese white dolphins, and state one limitation. (3 marks)
